info.title: QatuPOS staff laboratory pilot API
info.description: Single branch cloud-writer laboratory, PostgreSQL real state. Not G2, no real payments, printing, SUNAT issuance, Qatu/Delivery/QR or offline claims. UUID IDs and integer PEN cents, whole sale quantities only. Client cannot supply tenant/branch/role/price; scope from session. Commands strict; same actor+scope+operation_id+canonical body returns stable result without duplicate effects, different body conflicts. Local guest key increment: only waiter activates; positive fully-paid check settles access; browser-private guest orders reuse core writer. QR/NFC hardware, public LAN and real providers remain disabled. Corrective011: quotes single-use and actor-bound, expiry exclusive. Simulated fiscal documents do not establish fiscal acceptance: check remains pending. NC supports total01/06 and02factura only;03/07 return UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY. No fake QR, XML signature, transmission or certification.

get.description: Session-scoped snapshot, Cache-Control no-store. Never transport hidden financial records to waiter/kitchen. Counting participants get null expected cash/on-hand/reserved/available until declaration sealed; raw state remains numeric. Admin has same blind redaction during own participation. Kitchen sees only assigned station order lines/jobs; waiter sees table check charge/paid/held summary but no payment evidence, cash, custody, audits. staff metadata minimal no passwords. No tenant/role query override.

post.description: Validate discriminated payload then scope/role/entity-version and cross-module invariants under single PostgreSQL branch-writer transaction. Idempotency effect+inbox result+outbox atomic. Check duplicate operation before expected_version validation, recover old result without re-executing. A replay response snapshot may be freshly projected for authorized actor; entity_id remains original. No external calls here. Operation identifiers unique per branch and bound original actor/body; other actor cannot use ID to retrieve sensitive result.

TableOpenCommand.description: Lock table and check expected table version. Create one visit and primary check, no charge; increment table version.

TableCloseCommand.description: Check visit expected version; require fully fulfilled lines, total exactly paid, no retained authorizations/unknown; close check and visit, release physical table. Fiscal remains pending laboratory.

OrderCreateCommand.description: Use visit version. Server resolves active product price/route/version, positive whole units, freezes commercial snapshot and adds one accepted batch to primary Check; reserve stock and enqueue durable station jobs atomically. Never a Caja print.

LinePrepareCommand.description: Station ACL and line version; only Cocina/Heladeria; positive delta not greater than outstanding target. Unit stock is consumed on fulfillment, none policy no stock. Recipes unsupported in this lab.

LineFulfillCommand.description: Delta delivered once with line version. Caja directly consumes reserved unit stock in transaction; other stations require already prepared quantities. Blocking beverage custody cut rejects delivery. Caja delivery requires an open current-day cash custody, and is blocked during handover or after day closure.

PrintCopyCommand.description: Original must be known, reason required; creates new immutable copy_of job and new payload hash, no order/stock effect. Ambiguous paper is never automatically retried.

PrintAckCommand.description: Laboratory simulated paper evidence. Enforce station ACL and valid state transitions; bridge_received does not prove paper. Network hardware is disabled.

CollectionAuthorizeCommand.description: Owner-role CashSession open; Check version and positive available balance. Durable quota reservation, Check increment and laboratory-local registry ACK atomically before success. Production cloud registry not implemented.

PaymentConfirmCommand.description: Consume authorization once, derive amount/check/scope/method. cash requires received_minor >= amount and no merchant evidence; card/Yape require evidence and prohibit received_minor. Check session still open and owned. Confirmed payment creates cash movement only for cash; no bank settlement or fiscal inference.

PaymentUnknownCommand.description: Noncash authorization only, consumes capability and retains held balance, durable unknown attempt with reason. Never release by timeout or shift/day close.

PaymentResolveCommand.description: Unknown digital only, merchant_verified evidence deduped. Confirm in specified active owned cash session/current collecting day; preserve initiated_cash_session_id and original created_at. No reopening a historical cut.

CashOpenCommand.description: No active/counting session on single branch drawer. Server-owned day version and owner; opening is external float only. Successor after handover is exclusively handover.accept.

CashMoveCommand.description: Open owned CashSession version, external paid_in/paid_out with reason; positive exact cents, forbid paid_out exceeding expected physical cash. Not a sale.

HandoverBeginCommand.description: Outgoing owner plus distinct incoming cashier/admin. Freeze cash and all Caja stock resources atomically, record stable cut/expected snapshot and pending payment references; do not release unknown. Other-station preparation can continue.

HandoverCountCommand.description: Outgoing owner declares exact whole counts for entire frozen Caja resource set once and blind physical cash. Declaration does not mutate stock; seal and reveal expectations/differences.

HandoverApproveCommand.description: Distinct administrator from outgoing/incoming; only declared/disputed discrepancy and reason. Persist independent approval only; barrier stays sealed. Acceptance applies authorized append-only stock adjustment exactly once atomically with successor session. No selfapproval. Independent admin may review a disputed handover, preserving sealed counts and rejection reason; returns to declared for receiving employee acceptance. All approval/rejection reasons remain immutable audit entries, including reapproval after a previous approval.

HandoverAcceptCommand.description: Only nominated incoming actor distinct from outgoing; require sealed counts and independent approval for nonzero differences. Atomic close outgoing/open successor with declared physical cash and same-day stock custody once. Internal float transfer is not revenue.

HandoverRejectCommand.description: Incoming nominee only, retain declaration/cut and reason as disputed. No releasing barrier or reopening historical session; independent approval/recovery required.

DayCloseCommand.description: Owned active session version + server day version. Atomic final blind cash/Caja stock declaration and last session close. Sum unique confirmed payment IDs and distinct sales, separate prior-day collections, external cash flows and internal floats. Pending fiscal/unknown/open checks/differences force provisional. No issuing SUNAT document. Only latest cash session of CURRENT business day can close or revise that day. Optional operational_final is only for owned open nocturnal cash: no balances/delivery/reservations/unknown/counts, physical stock equals book; cash variance requires independent sealed approval. Overall fiscal state remains provisional. Provisional cannot revise a previously final operational close.

InventoryCountCommand.description: Caja propietario solo SKU Caja; admin cualquier estación. Retiene SKU hasta aprobación independiente. Reconteo solapado debe cubrir todos los SKU de declaraciones sustituidas.

InventoryAdjustCommand.description: Admin diferente de declarador; día vigente abierto, estado declared, versiones iguales y contado >= reservado. Legacy/sin día409 BUSINESS_DAY_LOCKED; faltante reservado409 STOCK_RESERVATIONS_EXCEED_COUNT. Motivo siempre obligatorio.

SalesNoteCommand.description: Check expected version, internal counter/reference only, literal non-CPE legend. Does not create second sale or resolve fiscal obligation.

expected_stock_version.description: Versión registrada al declarar inventario; opcional en conteos históricos/traspasos.

DayOpenCommand.description: Admin only, current day provisionally_closed or reconciled and no active/counting cash session. Preserve closed BusinessDay and immutable close history. Server derives next date America/Lima: server date if later than old business_date; otherwise old date plus one strictly laboratory simulation. New UUID/day version, no client date. Open checks and unknown holds retain origin, new collections explicitly current day. Does not mark earlier pending resolved.

product_id.description: Opcional. Omitido genera UUID servidor. ID existente en este local (incluso inactivo) devuelve409 PRODUCT_ID_CONFLICT; replay operation_id conserva idempotencia.

stock_item_id.description: UUID de inventario de la misma estación para unit; null para none. En update, omitido conserva vínculo salvo cambio explícito a none, que lo limpia. Un SKU explícito siempre se procesa.

CatalogProductCreateCommand.description: Admin únicamente. Vínculo unit exige SKU existente de la misma estación; none no admite SKU no nulo. Cambios y auditoría son atómicos.

OrderLineVoidCommand.description: Caja/admin. Durante traspaso prepared/declared/disputed, liberar reservas o reintegrar stock de Caja devuelve409 RESOURCE_COUNTING. Otras estaciones y anulaciones sin efecto sobre stock contado conservan flujo. Ajuste de consumos de día anterior devuelve409 BUSINESS_DAY_LOCKED; requiere futuro libro de ajustes.

FiscalDocument.description: Internal synthetic simulation only. Digest is JSON hash, not signed UBL. accepted_simulated/annulled do not imply fiscal acceptance, payment reversal or stock return.

CheckDiscountApplyCommand.description: Ajuste de consumos de día anterior devuelve409 BUSINESS_DAY_LOCKED; requiere futuro libro de ajustes.

CheckDiscountRemoveCommand.description: Ajuste de consumos de día anterior devuelve409 BUSINESS_DAY_LOCKED; requiere futuro libro de ajustes.

LineReadyConfirmCommand.description: Staff records explicit station confirmation of prepared quantity when station uses paper only. Audit actor and reason; never infer from print acknowledgement or payment. Same prepared quantity invariant as kitchen preparation.

HandoverCancelCommand.description: Independent administrator cancels unaccepted custody transfer and reopens original drawer without any monetary or stock adjustment. Original sealed observations retained.
